_comment: Row definitions for /compare/. Every tool answers the same rows. `level` is executive or detail. Detail rows carry an `indicator` (accessibility, botability, security, usability, readability) or `platform` for cross-cutting capabilities. `concerns` on executive rows map to comparison/concerns.json.

executive.hint: Whether results are private to the account or public.
